text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the post-race press conference, Aston 
Machan loudly declared that the Oka Sho 
would be hers to take!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It became a huge topic of conversation 
that it would be a three-way battle 
featuring Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This excitement was no coincidence. It was 
the result of Aston Machan's planning and 
setting the stage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is, of course, the Oka Sho! 
She burned with determination to become 
the ultimate super mascot.
